questions.q: Which statement about RAM is correct?
options: It is non-volatile and holds the boot program
It is volatile and holds programs and data currently in use
It is read-only memory inside the CPU
questions.why: RAM is volatile main memory holding programs and data in use. Non-volatile read-only memory is ROM.

questions.q: Which type of storage uses a laser to read pits and lands?
questions.why: Optical discs (CD, DVD, Blu-ray) are read by a laser detecting pits and lands.

questions.q: Which translator converts a whole high-level program into machine code before it runs?
questions.why: A compiler translates the whole program in one go into an executable. An interpreter works line by line; an assembler handles assembly language.

questions.q: Explain why a hard disk drive may become slower over time and how defragmentation software helps.
questions.model: Over time the parts of a file become spread out (fragmented) around the disk, so the read/write head has to move to many places. Defragmentation rearranges the fragments so each file is stored together, which makes it quicker to read.
points: files become fragmented / stored in separate pieces so reading is slower
defragmentation puts the pieces of each file together to speed up access
